author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: সঠিক Wh-প্রশ্ন তৈরি করো বা বেছে নাও।

items.q: Make a question: 'He goes to school by bus.' (asking how)
opts: How does he go to school?
items.rule_bn: উপায় জানতে 'How' + does + subject + base verb।

items.q: Make a question: 'She has two brothers.' (asking how many)
___ books do you need? (asking quantity, countable)
___ water do you want? (asking quantity, uncountable)
Make a question: 'This book is Rahim's.' (asking whose)
Make a question: 'He came yesterday.' (asking when)
items.rule_bn: সময় জানতে 'When' + did + subject + base verb।

items.q: ___ of these two pens do you want? (choosing between two)
Which is the correct question form?
